recognize_zh: 抹片中央與右下各見一個含空泡、胞質淡染的巨噬細胞，外圍緊貼一圈深藍色、圓核的紅母細胞，排列成玫瑰花環狀，這就是紅血球生成島（erythroblastic island）的「保母細胞」結構。
features: Central macrophages with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and an eccentric oval nucleus
Rosette of erythroblasts in intimate contact with the macrophage cytoplasm
Surrounding erythroblasts are small to intermediate with round dense nuclei and deeply basophilic to polychromatophilic cytoplasm
Three separate islands of varying size, the largest (lower right) with more than one layer of precursors
Scattered isolated erythroblasts and a blood-rich background; no blasts or abnormal lymphoid cells in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several erythroblastic islands, each composed of a central macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm encircled by one or more layers of erythroblasts at various stages of maturation. The erythroid precursors show orderly maturation without megaloblastic or dysplastic change. No leukemic blasts are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with prominent erythroblastic islands, a reactive feature reflecting active or stressed erythropoiesis, here in a post-transplant marrow in morphologic remission.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis the red cell precursors are engulfed within the macrophage cytoplasm rather than arranged around its surface.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor cluster
ddx.vs: Tumor clusters form cohesive sheets of uniform malignant cells without a central macrophage and lack hemoglobinized cytoplasm.
Lymphoblasts show fine chromatin, scant agranular cytoplasm and lie singly, not in rosettes with maturing hemoglobinized cytoplasm.
